news.title: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited (NSEI:NUVOCO) signed a letter of intent to acquire 26% stake in Clean Max Ilghop Private Limited for approximately INR 260 million.
news.body:
Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited (NSEI:NUVOCO) signed a letter of intent to acquire 26% stake in Clean Max Ilghop Private Limited for approximately INR 260 million on April 14, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 260 million will be paid by Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited. As part of consideration, INR 260 million is paid towards common equity of Clean Max Ilghop Private Limited. The investment is proposed to be undertaken through execution of a Share Purchase Agreement.

For the period ending March 31, 2026, Clean Max Ilghop Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 0.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by acquirer board. The deal has been approved by the board of Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited.
